_readme: Copy this file to client-material.config.json (same folder) to add rules. Both arrays ADD to the defaults and never remove one. blockedPrefixes: folders, relative to the project the plugin runs in, whose files never go to an outside model (Collaborations/ is always blocked). names: full names that must never appear in text sent to an outside model, matched ignoring case and spacing. Every folder with a space in its name directly under Collaborations/ is already a name. A config that does not parse or has the wrong shape makes every check refuse until you fix it.
